fusions.name: Cold Clang
fusions.desc: Rings your iron against the ground, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2.5 tiles. Each has a 50% chance to be left [Suppressed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hurled Ingot
fusions.desc: Hurls a block of cold iron that deals 32 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at 6 tiles, and ignores the target's resistances.

fusions.name: Unyielding Moment
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Hardened Core
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 15%, and you have 12% arcane resistance.
